ice.title: What is ICE?
ice.subtitle: Integrated Client Engine
ice.content:
ICE (Integrated Client Engine) is a complete funnel orchestration system that automates the entire client acquisition journey - from initial inquiry to payment confirmation.

It combines:
- Auto-qualification (PAIN/BUDGET/TIMELINE/FIT scoring)
- WhatsApp pre-sell drip sequences
- AI Twin presentation automation
- Closing script generation
- Payment follow-up automation
- ProofLoop™ for social proof collection
benefits: Shorten sales cycles from 45+ days to 20 days
Generate social proof from unqualified leads

proofloop.title: What is ProofLoop™?
proofloop.subtitle: Turn Unqualified Leads into Social Proof
proofloop.content:
ProofLoop™ is a system to extract value from leads who don't qualify for your high-ticket offer.

Instead of discarding them, you:
1. Collect their feedback on your presentation
2. Offer a bonus (playbook, checklist, template)
3. Request a video testimonial
4. Use that proof to convert future qualified leads

Result: Every lead - qualified or not - contributes to your marketing assets.
triggers: After slides viewed but not booked

traffic_engine.title: Traffic Engine
traffic_engine.subtitle: Three Pillars of High-Intent Traffic
traffic_engine.content:
The Traffic Engine uses three complementary strategies to fill your pipeline with qualified leads:

1. **Search Harvest**: SEO-optimized content targeting high-intent keywords
2. **Piggyback**: Guest spots on podcasts, newsletters, and YouTube channels your ICP already follows
3. **Partner Taps**: Strategic partnerships with communities and networks where your ICP hangs out

search_harvest.description: Capture buyers actively searching for solutions

piggyback.description: Leverage existing audiences via guest content
piggyback.pitch_template: Hi {host}, I help {ICP} solve {pain}. Would love to share {topic} with your audience.

partner_taps.description: Tap into communities where your ICP already congregates

ai_twin.title: AI Twin Presentation
ai_twin.subtitle: Automated Value-First Selling
ai_twin.content:
The AI Twin is a pre-recorded slide deck + video that educates prospects BEFORE the sales call.

Structure:
- Slides 1-16: Pure value (80%) - frameworks, insights, case studies
- Slides 17-20: Pitch (20%) - offer, investment, booking

Why it works:
1. Prospects self-qualify by watching
2. You don't waste time on unqualified demos
3. Qualified leads come pre-sold
4. Scales infinitely (no marginal time cost)

metrics.booking_rate: 40% of video completions book a call

scoring_system.title: PAIN/BUDGET/TIMELINE/FIT Scoring
scoring_system.subtitle: Auto-Qualify Leads Before You Talk
scoring_system.content:
Every applicant is scored on 4 dimensions:

1. **PAIN (40%)**: How acute is their problem?
2. **BUDGET (30%)**: Can they afford your offer?
3. **TIMELINE (20%)**: When do they need a solution?
4. **FIT (10%)**: Are they your ideal client profile?

Total score determines:
- ≥60: Qualified → ICE Nurturing → Closing Call
- <60: Rejected → ProofLoop™ → Social Proof
scoring_system.customization: Adjust weights and thresholds based on your niche and offer.

drip_sequences.title: WhatsApp Pre-Sell Drip
drip_sequences.subtitle: Nurture Leads to Show-Up Ready
drip_sequences.content:
After a lead qualifies, they enter a timed WhatsApp drip sequence:

- **T-72h**: Call confirmation + pain acknowledgment
- **T-24h**: Reminder + case study snippet
- **T-2h**: Final reminder + calendar link
- **T-15m**: Meeting link + quick prep tip

Result: 85%+ show-up rate (vs 50% industry average)
best_practices: Link to AI Twin slides in T-24h message

payment_automation.title: Payment Follow-Up Automation
payment_automation.subtitle: Post-Call Payment Nudges
payment_automation.content:
After a successful closing call, automate payment collection:

1. **Immediate**: Send payment link via WhatsApp
2. **T+24h**: Friendly reminder
3. **T+48h**: Check-in (address objections)
4. **T+72h**: Last nudge (scarcity/urgency)

Conversion: 60-70% token collection within 72h
